gbm_population_evidence.quote: Pathological diagnosis or molecular diagnosis for lesion this time was confirmed to be recurrent brain glioma (WHO grade 4).

candidate_evidence.quote: Patients in group A will receive neoadjuvant Camrelizumab (PD-1 antibody), followed by surgical resection, DC vaccines and further PD-1 inhibitor treatment until toxicity or progression.
Patients in group B will receive neoadjuvant Camrelizumab (PD-1 antibody), followed by surgical resection, placebo and further PD-1 inhibitor treatment until toxicity or progression.

candidate_flag.reason: Camrelizumab is given identically in both arms (C3 -> soc_backbone), leaving only the DC vaccine as the experimental agent; but the trial also frames neoadjuvant camrelizumab itself as investigational in recurrent GBM, which would make it a candidate.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Previous first-line therapy with radiotherapy and chemotherapy, first or second relapse with unequivocal evidence of tumor progression.

role_evidence.quote: Prior to scheduled surgery, patients need to receive Camrelizumab IV (3mg/kg, up to 200mg). After surgery, patients receive Camrelizumab IV (3mg/kg, up to 200mg) and Placebo IH every 3 weeks
The purpose of this study is to evaluate the safety and efficiency of using the neoadjuvant therapy with PD-1 antibody (Carilizumab) plus DC vaccine (GSC-DCV) in patients with recurrent glioblastoma.

flag.reason: Given equally in both arms (C3 soc_backbone), but neoadjuvant anti-PD-1 is part of the stated investigational strategy; could be a candidate.

arms: Neoadjuvant PD-1 inhibitor plus DC vaccine

role_evidence.quote: Vaccine, dendritic cells (DCs) pulsed with glioblastoma stem-like cell (GSC) antigens (GSC-DCV), could extend survival for GBM patients in our previous clinical study (PMID: 30159779).

agents.drug_class_hint: autologous dendritic cell vaccine pulsed with glioblastoma stem-like cell antigens (GSC-DCV)
arms: Neoadjuvant PD-1 inhibitor plus DC vaccine

biomarkers.biomarker_other: exploratory NGS panel (ctDNA, TIL density, TCR clonality, gene expression signature, genomic mutation, microbiome)

source_quote.quote: To investigate the association between biomarkers and clinical outcomes using diverse biospecimen based on the next generation sequencing, including ctDNA, TIL (tumor infiltrating lymphocyte) density and TCR (T cell receptor) Clonality, gene expression signature, genomic mutation

coder_notes: Randomised Phase II: neoadjuvant + adjuvant camrelizumab in both arms, randomised to GSC-DC vaccine vs placebo. Per C3, camrelizumab (given equally in all arms) coded soc_backbone; the randomised question is the DC vaccine (excluded type) -> no candidate, S6 excluded_intervention_type; flagged because the record also frames neoadjuvant camrelizumab as part of the investigational strategy (if adjudicated as candidate, it would be experimental_monotherapy, regimen monotherapy). Brief summary misspells 'Carilizumab'. Placebo not listed as an agent. Conditions say recurrent glioblastoma; inclusion 'WHO grade 4' glioma without IDH requirement and summary uses 'glioblastoma multiforme' -> historical. Comparator arm is a registered ACTIVE_COMPARATOR.
